findings.current: cite: 'Mandatory GB for light-vehicle AEB under development'; status: proposed
findings.proposed: GB 39901-2025 (Light-duty vehicle AEBS requirements and test methods), mandatory, published 2026-01-29, effective 2028-01-01 for new M1 type approvals (full content 2030-01-01; N1 phased from 2029); status phase-in. Verify against the SAMR notice before changing.
findings.evidence: Search snippet: '强制性国家标准《轻型汽车自动紧急制动系统技术要求及试验方法》(GB 39901-2025)于2026年1月29日正式发布，将于2028年1月1日正式实施 ... 新标准由推荐性转为强制性'. Not a single official-source confirmation (gov sites blocked).

findings.current: cite 'ADR 98/02 (car-to-car + pedestrian/cyclist)', status phase-in, only record au-f2026l00284
findings.proposed: ADR 98/02 appears to be the newer cyclist-detection stage layered on ADR 98/00 (car-to-car) and 98/01 (pedestrian). Reword cite to name 98/00, 98/01 and 98/02 separately; car-to-car and pedestrian AEB are already applied to new and all vehicles, so status is not simply phase-in. Records for ADR 98/00 and 98/01 are not in the repo. Application dates for 98/02 are unverified (consultation draft said 1 Nov 2027 new models / 1 Nov 2028 all).
findings.evidence: Search: 'ADR 98/02 ... prevent or mitigate collisions with bicyclists and expands on earlier ADR provisions that already address rear-end collisions and impacts involving pedestrians ... ADR 98/00 car-to-car ... ADR 98/01 pedestrian ... new models since August 2024'. Record au-f2026l00284 body is only the Federal Register page chrome; no dates in text.

findings.current: 'No CMVSS yet (voluntary commitment; tracking FMVSS 127)', status proposed
findings.proposed: Reword: Transport Canada consulted in 2020 on mandating AEB; no Canada Gazette proposal found. 'voluntary commitment' and 'tracking FMVSS 127' not supported by anything found; status 'proposed' may overstate (no published proposal).
findings.evidence: Search: TC consultation 1 Sep-7 Oct 2020; 'Canada Gazette Part I and Part II publications for this specific regulation have not been published yet'.

findings.current: CONTRAN 915/2022 (record br-contran-915) listed as light-vehicle (M1/N1) brake performance regulation
findings.proposed: CONTRAN 915/2022 concerns brake-system evaluation procedures and mandatory ABS or CBS for L-category vehicles (L3-L7, motorcycles/tricycles/quadricycles), not M1/N1. Remove from this light-vehicle row (or note 'motorcycles only') and say no Brazilian M1/N1 brake cell found. Record br-contran-915 also has no regulation text (summary admits 'only a title... without any substantive content').
findings.evidence: Search: 'Resolução CONTRAN 915/2022 ... obrigatoriedade do ABS e/ou CBS nos veículos das categorias L3, L4, L5, L6 e L7 ... motocicletas, motonetas, triciclos e quadricíclos'. Record body: 'Full text requires visiting the official CONTRAN resolution archive'; record tags vehicle_categories include Passenger car/Light truck.

findings.proposed: Retitle record as 'MVSR s. 135 - Light Vehicle Brake Systems (TSD 135)'. (Crosswalk citation CMVSS 135 itself is correct.)
findings.evidence: Record body: '135(1)Every passenger car... GVWR of 3 500 kg or less shall conform to ... Technical Standards Document No. 135, Light Vehicle Brake Systems (TSD 135)'.

findings.current: CMVSS 126 cell has no records link
findings.proposed: Add records: ca-mvsr-c-r-c---c--1038-s126 (exists in repo; MVSR s. 126 incorporating TSD 126, with Annex 9 of UN R13H alternative).
findings.evidence: Record body: '126(1)Every passenger car, multi-purpose passenger vehicle, truck and bus with a GVWR of 4 536 kg or less must conform to ... TSD 126, Electronic Stability Control Systems for Light Vehicles'.

findings.current: cite GB/T 30677-2014 listed first, no status
findings.proposed: Add status note: GB/T 30677-2014 is a recommended (GB/T) standard, not mandatory; mandatory ESC fitment comes only via GB 7258 for specified categories, not generally for M1.
findings.evidence: 'GB/T' prefix denotes recommended national standard; record title 'Performance requirements and testing methods for ESC for light vehicles'. Scope of GB 7258 ESC mandate not verified here.

findings.current: cite 'UN R130 (LDWS, heavy); UN R79 (ELKS / corrective steering)', records only ece-r79
findings.proposed: ELKS is not defined in UN R79; the EU 2021/646 ELKS text (LDWS + corrective directional control function) is tagged un_equivalent UN R130 in repo. Re-cite: UN R130 (LDWS; ELKS-equivalent requirements) and note R79 covers ACSF/corrective steering separately; add an R130 record (none in repo) and link it instead of/in addition to R79.
findings.evidence: eu-32021r0646 body: '2.1. An emergency lane-keeping system (ELKS) shall comprise a lane departure warning system (LDWS) and a corrective directional control function (CDCF)'; frontmatter un_equivalent: UN R130. ece-r79 body is a stub.

findings.proposed: Topic is LDW/ELKS but EU cell omits LDW for M2/M3/N2/N3 (UN R130 via 2019/2144) and gives no mandatory status or dates; add status and the 2019/2144 link (eu-32019r2144 exists).
findings.evidence: 2021/646 title: 'type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their emergency lane-keeping systems (ELKS)'; scope limited to M1/N1.

findings.current: cite 'KMVSS Art. 53-4', no status, no scope
findings.proposed: Add scope: applies only to school vans for children (bus category), not general passenger cars; status mandatory for those vans. Otherwise the row implies a general child-presence requirement in Korea.
findings.evidence: Record body: 'School vans for children shall be equipped with a child presence detection system ...'

findings.current: cite 'UN R157 (ALKS); UN R171 (DCAS, L2)', records only ece-r157
findings.proposed: R171 has no repository record; L2 DCAS is outside the topic title (ALKS/ADS L3+). Either add an R171 record or drop it from the cite.

findings.current: cite 'GB 44497-2024 (DSSAD); L3/L4 pilot access rules', record cn-gb-44497
findings.proposed: GB 44497-2024 is a data-storage (DSSAD) standard, not an ADS approval requirement; make clear it does not by itself approve L3+ ADS and cite the pilot access notice only if a source is added. Record summary/body are generic (cyber/ADAS boilerplate, 'Regulated Area: Active safety / braking / ADAS') and do not match the DSSAD title.
findings.evidence: Record body: 'Ensure electronic systems are resilient to cyber/software risks...' and 'Possible functional overlap: GB 4094-2016 - Symbols for Controls...' vs title 'Data storage system for automated driving'.

findings.proposed: AIS-145 speed alert (beeps at 80 and 120 km/h, M1) is a fixed-threshold overspeed alert, not speed-limit awareness ISA; add note that it is not equivalent to (EU) 2021/1958, and no repository record backs the cell.
findings.evidence: Search: 'speed alert system ... beep sound twice in a minute above 80 km/h, continuous above 120 km/h ... applicable to M1'.

findings.current: cn-gb-27887-2024 body/summary describe vehicle-side ISOFIX anchorages and CRS fit zones
findings.proposed: GB 27887-2024 is the child restraint product standard (replaces GB 27887-2011, effective 2025-07-01, mandatory, CCC-covered); record text/summary describe anchorage requirements (that is GB 14167), so it does not support the 'products' topic. Dates in crosswalk are correct.
findings.evidence: Search: 'GB 27887-2024 机动车儿童乘员用约束系统 ... 实施日期 2025-07-01 ... 完全替代 GB 27887-2011'. Record body: 'ISOFIX/LATCH lower anchors, top tether anchors, child restraint fit zones'; body is generic boilerplate, paywalled.
